$comment: Round 2 re-verification on vcst-qa after the VCST-5589 REOPEN. Round 1 (2026-08-03, vcptcore-qa) is recorded in verification-report.md / verification-summary.json in this same folder.

build.build_identity_proof: Static: the deployed bundle index-DK7fXvSJ.js carries the new sales-rep constants block (…Ixe="sales-rep-dashboard",kXe="New",gXe="active-carts",pXe=5,fXe="cache-and-network"), exported as `bi` and consumed by the dashboard / customer-profile / my-customers / sales-reps / useSalesRepCustomersCount chunks; useSalesRepRules retains an explicit fetchPolicy:"cache-first" (the PR's documented exclusion). Theme pin in vc-deploy-dev@vcst-qa matches PR head SHA 7bfde57d.

ac_analysis.drift_detail: AC 'cache is invalidated after every mutation that affects a statistics metric' is not implemented literally — the PR implements mount-time revalidation instead. Declared by the author, accepted as scope in the round-1 reopen, and it satisfies every scenario in the ticket's own repro steps. No post-mutation eviction and no polling: a widget already on screen does not live-update until the rep navigates back. Still pending the TTL / auto-refresh decision the ticket's Notes asked the reporter to specify.

blocked_detail: 089 pagination is unreachable on this seed (5 assigned customers < page size 10, so no pagination control renders). Data-coverage limit, not a defect.

promotion.$comment: APPLIED at 5i with user authorization, then independently re-verified row-by-row against the CSVs (13/13 match, Promoted stamps present). Split derived from REG-2026-08-05-0342 plus the targeted-lane evidence. {SPEC}→{OBSERVED} conversion was deliberately conservative: only assertions traceable to a specific artifact were grounded; assertions where the evidence could not distinguish 'this mount's own value' from 'still the prior mount's value' (because the underlying data did not change between mounts) were left {SPEC}.

blocked.reason: ASSERTION_DEFECT — the case asserts the sidebar badge query refires on an in-hub route change, but the badge lives in a persistent layout that never unmounts on such navigation. Stays Draft pending a /qa-review-tests rewrite around the real mount boundary (layout entry/exit or reload).

regression.$gate_note: The ≥95% Feature Release Gate threshold is NOT honestly evaluable on this run: 77 of 177 cases are BLOCKED on fixture/credential provisioning gaps (SR_REP_PAGING, SR_REP_NOCUSTOMERS, ACME_BUYER), deliberate non-mutation of a shared env, and a real tooling gap (no route-interception in the playwright MCP surface for error-injection cases). None reflect on PR #2412. The narrower decision-relevant question IS evaluable: after correcting SR-FE-050, zero of the 9 FAILs are attributable to this PR.

blocked_followup.$comment: Post-verdict follow-up: the 77 BLOCKED cases in REG-2026-08-05-0342 were categorized by real root cause, the fixture-blocked subset was provisioned/repaired, and only that subset was re-run (19 cases, 2 lanes). The ticket verdict above is unaffected — none of this concerns PR #2412.

module_version_gate.detail: SR-CP-036..050 + SR-HD-019..046 need SalesRep 3.1001.0-pr-6 (saved-layout API, VCST-5367). Deployed build is 3.1000.0; live schema introspection returns 15 salesRep* Query fields and salesRepLayout is NOT among them, and no salesRepLayout request ever fires. Deployment matter, not data.

fixture_gap_repaired.detail: Re-run below. Almost entirely credential REPAIR, not new seeding — ACME_BUYER had drifted credentials (the same failure ensureSecurityAccount records from the 2026-07-29 audit).

tooling_gap.detail: No route interception in the Playwright MCP surface for error-injection cases.

shared_store_setting.detail: Require toggling SalesRep.Enabled=false on the shared store — disruptive to concurrent testers.

cascade_of_real_defect.detail: SR-FE-046/047 cascade from SR-FE-045 (no filter chips render). Related evidence: salesRepCustomerFilterRules returns a single rule 'All' — possibly the root cause; attach to that ticket.

admin_creds.detail: SR-HD-048 / SR-FE-MSR-022 — both closed directly in the targeted lanes.

other.detail: SR-HD-012 (no period control on this build), SR-FE-MSR-004, SR-FE-MSR-014 (needs >10 reps for one buyer — skipped as disproportionate).

rerun.failed_detail: SR-FE-013 — expects a redirect to Dashboard for a zero-customer rep; no redirect occurs, the empty state renders instead. Classified TEST DEFECT / stale baseline, not a product bug: fixture drift was ruled out first (the account genuinely has no org and no Corporate section), zero rows are returned, the backend agrees, and the {OBSERVED} baseline was captured 2026-07-17 on vcptcore-qa on an older build. The route guard has been relaxed from org-context to role-only. Needs a dev confirm that this was intentional, and it disproves the rationale for deprecating SR-FE-030 ('a permissioned rep with zero customers is architecturally unreachable').
rerun.still_blocked_detail: SR-FE-018 (needs a mid-test admin un-assignment of 5+ orgs from SR_REP_PAGING plus restore — would mutate a fixture three other cases in the same run depend on); SR-CP-033 (two independent blockers: no period control exists in the UI — the page sends a hardcoded YTD window with no user affordance, pending the VCST-5368/5308 design decision — and all 5 ACME orders share one timestamp, so there is no intra-period variation to narrow on).
rerun.partial_detail: SR-FE-042 — the [STATE] half passed (inbox is per-user, not org-filtered: 3 notifications and unread count 3 identical before and after an org switch). The [DOM] half still needs a rep-sent push targeted at org A and a second at org B; the inbox holds only generic broadcasts. The case is DESIGN-CONFIRM, so it cannot yield a product verdict regardless.

new_findings: Two real defects in the repo's own sales-rep stats seeder, found and fixed: `--teardown --dry-run` ACTUALLY DELETED both carts (carts are removed over GraphQL and gql() had no dry-run short-circuit, unlike api()); and the shaped order rebuilt on every reseed against drifting products (the products query ran without sort over a 4523-product catalogue, so the 500-product scan was a shifting window). Both guarded, with a mutation-tested regression test.

B-15: salesRepTopSellers hard-errors without storeId, which is exactly what SR-HD-010's step instructs the tester to omit — that case's API assertion is unrunnable as written. The widget's own call does pass storeId, so only the case step is broken; the backend max-10 cap stays unverified at that layer.

SR-CP-015 / SR-CP-020 each carry a VCST-5367 [API] sub-check asserting a salesRepLayout request is issued. It cannot fire on this build. Both were synced from a vcptcore-qa confirmation — the CSV should mark that sub-check build-gated rather than let it read as a silent FAIL on vcst.

Accessibility (unfiled): the clear/reset '×' button in the My Sales Reps search input has no accessible name — surfaces as a bare `button` in the a11y tree while its sibling is correctly labelled 'Search sales reps'. WCAG 2.1 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.

Minor discrepancy worth noting: the data engineer's API probe reported ACME_BUYER seeing 5 reps (incl. Sam Store); the live storefront shows 4, because SR_REP_SECOND_STORE is Electronics-store-scoped and the caller is on B2B-store. The live figure is the correct one for UI assertions.

bugs_proposed.title: Sales Rep statistics aggregation lags live orders after an order-status change
bugs_proposed.provenance: OUT-OF-SCOPE (backend, pre-existing, not introduced by PR #2412)
bugs_proposed.evidence: After reverting AGENT-TEST-SRO-ACME-NEW to New, salesRepCustomerOrderStatistics kept returning 4 / $262.00 FROM THE SERVER while salesRepOrders returned New. Arithmetic 90+70+60+42 = $262 confirms the New set excluding the $120 order. Self-corrected in ~4.5 min. Discriminator ratified by the Step-5 verifier: a page reload would NOT fix it, so it is outside this ticket's defect class.

bugs_proposed.title: Untranslated i18n key 'Sales_rep.navigation.link' rendered in the Sales Rep sidebar
bugs_proposed.evidence: Corporate section, third link (/company/sales-reps) renders the raw key instead of a label; sibling links resolve normally.

bugs_proposed.title: Sales-rep nav badge can show a stale count during a long in-hub session
bugs_proposed.provenance: OUT-OF-SCOPE (design limit of mount-time revalidation, not a regression)
bugs_proposed.evidence: The badge only refetches at AccountLayout mount, so a served-customer count that changes server-side while the rep stays entirely within /account + /company pages is not picked up until they leave that area or reload. Narrower and self-healing versus the original bug; does not reinstate VCST-5589.

test_defects_routed.note: Also withdraw BUG_089_003 (High) from REG-2026-08-05-0342 — its stated root cause ('count query not migrated to cache-and-network') is disproven by the PR diff, the deployed bundle, and three live firefox observations.
Stale assertions against VCST-5367's 5-card stat layout, which splits data across cards differently than these assertions assume.

appinsights.skipped_reason: No APPINSIGHTS_API_KEY configured and no Azure MCP connected in this session. Skipped per the /qa-test 5a graceful-skip rule; does not block the verdict.

process_findings: The regression orchestrator returned control after dispatching batch 1, ending its turn while believing it would await child completions; the suites were dispatched twice. The two suite-089 result files are byte-identical across all 50 cases, so this produced no verdict divergence — but it means duplicate-run agreement is NOT evidence of correctness here, since both runs followed the same flawed premise.

Playwright --secrets carries no ADMIN_PASSWORD, so no browser-driven Admin mutation is possible; the out-of-band levers had to run as harness-side Platform REST calls, which the auto-mode permission classifier gates. Two narrow Bash allow rules were added for purpose-built scripts.

A seeder run does NOT clear a temporary account lockout (it resets the password only); PUT /api/platform/security/users with a cleared lockoutEnd returns succeeded:true and silently no-ops. Only POST /security/users/{GUID}/unlock works. Backlog B-11.

No rep has a phone seeded while suite 090 asserts a non-empty Phone cell — that assertion can only fail today, and it fails looking exactly like the rendering bug it was written to catch. Backlog B-12.
